name: Mana
description: You have 2 level-1 spell slots. Expend one to cast a prepared level-1 spell. You regain all expended mana after a Long Rest.

name: Lay on Hands
description: You have a pool of healing power with 5 Hit Points per Paladin level (each use box is 1 HP of the pool). As a Bonus Action, touch a creature to restore any number of Hit Points remaining in the pool. You can instead expend 5 HP from the pool to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature. The pool refills after a Long Rest.
